title: Final Intensity Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct formula for intensity as a function of R.

title: Max Intensity Location
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the value of R that maximizes the intensity.

title: Total Power Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the total power incident on the floor correctly.

title: Energy Loss Rate
description: Important Criteria: The student must relate the power to the energy loss rate correctly.

title: Amplitude Decay Time
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the time τ when amplitude is reduced to d/e.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the intensity formula.

title: Energy Expectation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should comment on whether the calculated total power aligns with expectations.
